# Feature: CLI Entrypoint

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-13 — issue #11 -->

## Intent
Humans and agents need a stable command, not an internal script. `packages/cli` is the npx entrypoint (Commander), with documented subcommands (`init`, `doctor`, `run`, `ci` as stubs) and exit code 2 on invalid CLI usage.

## Preconditions
- TypeScript workspace gates exist (#2)
- No discovery, Playwright, or dashboard server

## Happy Path
- [ ] A bin entrypoint exists and prints `--help` including planned commands
- [ ] Invalid usage exits with code 2 (PRD exit codes; 1 is budget-fail)
- [ ] CLI starts with no network access
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches (typed-strict / Boy Scout)

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Unknown flag → exit 2, not 1

## Regression
- [ ] Existing packages and `pnpm checks` stay green
- [ ] Scope: `packages/cli/**` plus root `package.json` bin field

## Assumptions
- Bin names: `potato-boost` and `potato`
- Stub commands print a short English line and exit 0
- Help and errors must not include stack traces or host paths

## Security Coverage
- P-02: help/errors have no stack, secrets, or internal filesystem paths
- No shell interpolation of user argv (Commander argv array)
- Auth/upload checklist: out of scope

## Screenshots
Not applicable.

## Implementation Notes
- Commander program in `packages/cli`; root and package `bin` point at `dist/bin.js` (`potato-boost` and `potato`).
- `runCli(argv, io)` never interpolates a shell string. Usage errors (unknown command/flag) return exit 2, not 1.
- Help/errors go through injected IO and omit stacks and host paths. Subcommands are stubs that print one English line.
